column1: # Consumed by install/20-plugins.sh. Tab-separated. Blank lines and lines
# ref is a commit SHA, tag, or branch name.
#   - A SHA pins the checkout exactly and is what you want for plugins:
#   - `.oh-my-zsh` is deliberately tracked by BRANCH, not SHA. Oh My Zsh
#     updates itself via `zstyle ':omz:update' mode auto` in lib/20-omz.zsh,
#     so pinning it to a SHA would mean the installer and OMZ's own updater
#     fight each other on every run. install/20-plugins.sh therefore only
#     clones OMZ if missing and never force-resets it.
# To bump a plugin: change the ref here, then run `zsh-update --plugins`.
